With those three snippets in place, you now have:

1. A new `flushAlignment` prop (default `false`).  
2. A new CSS class modifier `--flush-alignment` on the root `<ul>`.  

From here you can write the corresponding Sass rule, for example:

```scss
.#{\$prefix}--accordion {
  &--flush-alignment {
    .#{\$prefix}--accordion__heading,
    .#{\$prefix}--accordion__content {
      padding-left: 0;
    }
  }
}
```

…or whatever styles your design spec requires.
